_comment: A1772 performance budget. Measured by scripts/check-performance.js on a throttled school-device profile (4x CPU, 1.5 Mbps, 150 ms). Values are regression guards: roughly 1.5x the measured cold first-visit baseline. Raise a budget only with a measured reason in review.
_method: A2017 changed two things in the harness so the numbers model a real first visit. Text responses are gzip encoded (GitHub Pages and Netlify both compress HTML, CSS and JS in transit) and every measurement now starts in a fresh browser context with an empty cache. Before this, the 1440 run reused the 390 run's downloads and reported a warm revisit, which also made the desktop CLS figure jump between 0.114 and 0.332. Budgets below were re-set from three cold runs on 2026-10-30. The launch target for LCP on the homepage and the workshop hub is 2.5 s; those two budgets sit just above it so a regression toward the old 4.5 s first paint fails the gate.
